Cookie and Tracking Technology Preferences We and third parties use cookies and other tracking technologies, such as web beacons, pixels, and tags to gather information about you, your device, and how you interact with and communicate through our website. Although we do not "sell" this information for money, some disclosures to third parties could be considered a “sale” as defined under applicable law. Other disclosures and sharing are also for targeted advertising purposes. See our Privacy Statement for more information. To opt out of disclosures that may be a “sale” or sharing for targeted advertising, you should both: (A) submit an Opt-Out of Sale / Sharing / Targeted Advertising request through our Privacy Portal , and (B) disable the “Sale / Sharing / Targeted Advertising” toggle below. Disabling a toggle below will place a cookie on your browser signaling that you have opted out. Please note: The opt-out cookie only applies to this website and only to the browser and device you are using at the time you make the selection. You will also need to disable the toggle on each browser on each device you use, and on each Volkswagen Group website you access. If you clear cookies on your browser, you will need to disable the toggle in the Preference Center from that browser again. If you have blocked cookies through your browser settings, we will be unable to comply with choices you make here.
